objective: Project exact currency-isolated acquisition cost per quoted relationship and per bound relationship over one explicit canonical relationship cohort.
costBasis: sum of acquisitionCostMinorUnits across every relationship in the explicit cohort, isolated by currency
rules: The caller supplies the explicit relationship cohort.
Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated.
Exactly one attributed economics view must exist for every canonical cohort relationship.
No attributed economics view may exist outside the explicit cohort.
Each view analytics relationship identity must match the view relationship identity.
Relationship analytics must use the canonical acquisition analytics projection version.
Outcome analytics must use canonical outcome semantics through INS-003V validation.
Outcome analytics relationshipCount must equal the canonical explicit cohort size.
Acquisition cost is summed independently by currency.
Currencies are never converted or combined.
Cost per quote is total cohort acquisition cost in one currency divided by distinct quoted relationships.
Cost per bind is total cohort acquisition cost in one currency divided by distinct bound relationships.
The projection preserves numerator and denominator exactly and performs no arithmetic division.
A zero quoted denominator omits costPerQuote.
A zero bound denominator omits costPerBind.
Premium is not revenue and is not part of cost-per-outcome.
Commission and contribution are not part of cost-per-outcome.
